title: Is Per-Agent Policy Composition Safe? Rethinking Successor-Feature Transfer in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.11658v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many reinforcement learning systems, from fleet management to traffic signal control, must serve an objective that changes dynamically after deployment, and retraining a policy for each new objective is prohibitively expensive. For a single agent, this problem is well understood: successor features with generalized policy improvement, together with their universal extension, recombine a library of learned policies into a policy for any new objective, with a guarantee that the result is never worse than any policy in the library. However, multi-agent transfer has received far less attention, and the common practice of letting each agent recombine its own library independently inherits the recipe but not the guarantee. translated_title: 按智能体策略组合是否安全？重新思考协作多智能体强化学习中的后继特征迁移
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11658v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：许多强化学习系统，从车队管理到交通信号控制，必须在部署后服务于动态变化的目标，而为每个新目标重新训练策略代价高昂。对于单个智能体，这个问题已得到充分理解：具有广义策略改进的后继特征及其通用扩展，将学习到的策略库重新组合成针对任何新目标的策略，并保证结果不会比库中任何策略更差。然而，多智能体迁移受到的关注要少得多，常见的做法是让每个智能体独立地重新组合自己的策略库，这继承了方法但未继承保证。我们证明，这种独立组合可能产生比库中每个策略都严格更差的联合行为，因为重新组合队友会改变每个智能体所面临的环境，并使它重新组合的值失效。
tldr: 本文证明在多智能体强化学习中，各智能体独立进行后继特征策略组合可能产生比策略库中所有策略更差的联合行为，因此这种常见做法缺乏安全保障。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that independent successor-feature policy composition in multi-agent reinforcement learning can yield joint behavior strictly worse than any policy in the library, highlighting the lack of safety guarantees in this common practice.
